measurement.observed_useful_span_definition: last_meaningful_progress_at - substantive_work_started_at; diagnostic only until internal evidence-gap audit passes
measurement.continuous_progress_rule: Only spans whose durable evidence-point gaps all satisfy the <=120s contract may be promoted to counted useful span.
measurement.window_useful_coverage_definition: sum of evidenced useful intervals inside the intended 900-second window, excluding unexplained gaps and known idle/waiting
measurement.target_operating_model: >=840s evidenced useful coverage per intended 900s window
measurement.feasibility_rule: If scheduler delivery delay + startup overhead exceeds 60 seconds in a non-overlapping 900-second window, a single worker cannot mathematically reach 840 useful seconds before the next quarter boundary; classify the window as scheduler-budget-constrained rather than blaming worker effort.
